## History

Jonas Blake was a theological student from St. [Columbia](../codex/places.md#columbia) who had previously graduated from [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), having tried for a long time to avoid entering the ministry. While staying at Cousin Emily's boarding house over the summer, he met [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md). Despite his serious nature and plain appearance, Philippa fell in love with him.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Jonas P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002), [v3 ch.Jonas P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 ch.Jonas P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 ch.Jonas P18](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0018), [v3 ch.Jonas P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), +46 more_

## Relationships

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jonas--phil-gordon.md)

[Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) met Jonas while staying at Cousin Emily's boarding house during a summer spent at [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point). Although she initially tried to deny her feelings because Jonas is serious and lacks conventional good looks, she fell deeply in love with him. The two spent time together boating and walking along the sands, eventually becoming engaged to be married.

- Friend of — good chums who boated and walked on sands together  <sub>[v3 ch.Jonas P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>
- Romantically involved with — engaged to be married  <sub>[v3 ch.Charming P18](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0018), [v3 ch.Christine P9](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0009), [v3 ch.Confidences P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), +3 more</sub>
